title: A Research-Informed Module on Quantum Superposition for Rapid Classroom Adoption
summary: We present an adoption-ready instructional module for introducing quantum superposition in a two-state system. The package combines a five-activity classroom sequence with grading-ready assessment materials organized around six conceptual barriers documented in the physics education research literature: interpreting superposition as physical splitting, confusing coherent superposition with classical mixture, making basis-change errors, misreading finite-sample fluctuations as changes in the underlying state, using inconsistent notation, and, in an optional extension, reasoning about ordered…
